title: Pure Frog
summary: Pure Frog Rank 2 control build, pairing classic Aqua amphibians with modern disruption and staples. The deck circumvents the ban of Ronintoadin through Swap Frog hand loops and graveyard recycling to reliably establish Toadally Awesome for repeated negates, monster theft, and Standby Phase recursion.

summary.title: Starters & Swarming
points: Swap Frog Special Summons itself from hand by discarding any WATER monster, sends a Level 2 or lower Aqua monster (Dupe Frog, Poison Draw Frog, or Treeborn Frog) from Deck to GY, and returns a monster you control to hand for an additional Frog Normal Summon.
Substitoad tributes any monster you control to Special Summon any Frog monster directly from your Deck.
Tradetoad tributes an Aqua monster you control to target and revive any Frog monster from your GY.
Dupe Frog searches any Frog monster from your Deck or GY when sent from the field to the GY, and prevents the opponent from targeting other monsters for attacks.

summary.title: Opening: Swap Frog + WATER Monster
steps: Discard a WATER monster to Special Summon Swap Frog from your hand.
Activate Swap Frog's trigger effect to send Dupe Frog from your Deck to the GY.
Return Swap Frog from the field to your hand to gain an additional Normal Summon of a Frog monster this turn.
Normal Summon Swap Frog again using the extra summon, sending Poison Draw Frog (or a second Dupe Frog) from your Deck to the GY.
Normal Summon another Level 2 Aqua monster (such as Dupe Frog or Tradetoad), or revive Dupe Frog via Tradetoad.
Overlay the two Level 2 Aqua monsters to Xyz Summon Toadally Awesome.

summary.title: Boss & Negation Loop
points: Toadally Awesome detaches an Xyz material during either player's Standby Phase to Special Summon any Frog monster directly from your Deck (such as Dupe Frog to protect Toadally Awesome).

Once per turn, when the opponent activates a card or effect, Toadally Awesome sends 1 Aqua monster from your hand or face-up field to the GY to negate the activation, destroy that card, and Set it to your field.
When Toadally Awesome is sent to the GY, it targets 1 WATER monster in your GY (including itself or Swap Frog) and adds it back to your hand.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Rain of Frogs is a powerful continuous disruption Trap: while you control an Aqua monster with 2000 or more ATK (such as Toadally Awesome), it sends all non-Aqua monsters on the field to the GY, and Sets itself from the GY if destroyed by an opponent's card.
Froggy Forcefield is a Mirror Force variant for the archetype that destroys all Attack Position monsters the opponent controls when an opponent declares an attack on a face-up Frog monster.

summary.title: Left out
summary.text: Ronintoadin is Forbidden under the TCG banlist and omitted from the deck. The page's Spright and Paleozoic variant engines are excluded to keep the list purely focused on Frogs.
